absolute_rotation.doc: Replace the rotation instead of adding to it

offset_max.doc: Largest random offset added to each point position

offset_min.doc: Smallest random offset added to each point position

rotation_max.doc: Largest random rotation in degrees, Euler XYZ

scale_max.doc: Largest random scale multiplier per axis

scale_min.doc: Smallest random scale multiplier per axis

seed.doc: Seed mixed with each point seed for the random draws

uniform_scale.doc: One random factor for all axes (from the X range)
